groups.rule: Backend native SSOT (docs/API.md). TIEN: net_total/vat_amount/grand_total tu draft-doc calculate_taxes_and_totals, khong hand-compute; product_total + cylinder_total + vat_amount = grand_total. HOLD <=> Tra truoc AND 0 < advance_paid < required_deposit; Tra sau never HOLD. QUYEN (_guards.py): reads require_doc read; sales create/submit require_roles Sales + require_doc create/submit; record_order_deposit/accountant_approve_procurement accounting-only; user.get_list System Manager only; get_boot allowlisted own-session+CSRF. CAM: ignore_permissions, get_all tren du lieu phan quyen (dung get_list), allow_guest du lieu noi bo, raw-SQL prod mutation, hand-rolled money/tax, hardcoded commercial constants. QUERY: get_list permission-aware, frappe.qb join 1 query (no N+1), pypika Table.alias la internal attr (resolve alias batch get_list), Order import tu frappe.query_builder. Output JSON [{path,content,severity: critical|high|medium|low,category}].

Visual custom only (docs/UI.md). Client thu input -> api() (composables/useSession.js, noi duy nhat goi fetch) -> render; mutate xong doc lai server. CAM Floor: v-html, raw fetch, Math.random lam document ID, hardcoded email/user (identity tu get_boot), hardcoded option/default/label/order (config tu native: Custom Field/Property Setter/Layout/Item Group/min_order_qty/Payment Terms/Credit Limit/Tax Template), checker-silencing comments, secret, stub TODO/FIXME/NotImplementedError, mock server/CSRF/API. UI: custom_alias trong bang, header 1 dong, trang thai chu Viet + mau (>=4.5:1), so can phai tabular-nums, native <dialog> + vue-sonner. TRAP thuc chien: open redirect (redirect-to/query param gan thang location khong validate internal path / khong //), hardcode route 2 cho gay drift, so sanh chuoi cung response de vo. Output JSON [{path,content,severity,category}].

Data integrity (docs/DATA.md). TRAP thuc chien: zero gia mat traceability (ghi note nguon nhu pattern TMD-00004), ma moi lech chung tu goc (verify quy cach vs Q-doc/anh OCR), body Q-doc mau thuan heading chot (sua cau hoi cu cho khop), standard_rate=0 thanh gia mac dinh (de trong hoac xac nhan import xu ly 0 dung), brand trong vs rule so huu (ghi ro chu y), referential ma truc trong note (verify ton tai trong item_master), valuation=0 khi thieu BOM (dam bao BOM truoc nhap kho). Raw file la goc khi lech Sheet; thieu so de trong, khong doan. Output JSON [{path,content,severity,category}].
